ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this 28th day of June, 2017 (this “Agreement"), by and betweenNEWYORKCITYHOUSINGAUTHORITY,apublicbenefitcorporation established under thelaws of theStateof NewYorkand havinganoffice at 250Broadway,New HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND CORPORATION (the “HDFC"), a New York not-for-profit corporation duly organized pursuant to Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York, and Section 402 of the Not-for-Profit Corporation Law of the State of NewYork and having an office at 250Broadway,NewYork,NewYork 10007, as nominee for INGERSOLL SENIOR PARTNERS LLC, a limited liability company duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York and having an office at 150 Myrtle Avenue, 2nd hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Developer"). RECITALS: A.T The Authorityis the owner infee simple title ofthat certain land,with theBuildings (as hereinafter defined) and Improvements (as hereinafter defined) thereon, identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") as Block 2034, Lot 134 (formerly part of Lot 1),and by the street address of 112 St. Edwards Street, Brooklyn, New York, such land being more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Development Land"; and said land, existing Buildings and Improvements thereon, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto, and any new Buildings constructed thereon, being referred to hereinafter, collectively, as the "Development Property"). B. The Authority is the owner in fee title of that certain land,with the Buildings and Improvements thereon,identified on the Tax Map as Block 2034,Lot 1, and by the street address of 118 St. Edwards Street, Brooklyn, New York, such land being more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being referred tohereinafter as the Authority's Land"; and said land, existing Buildings and Improvements thereon, together with any future replacements, additions, or alterations thereto, and any new Building constructed thereon, being referred to hereinafter, collectively, as the“Authority's Property"). C. The Authority's Land and Development Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance of at least 10 linear feet that meets the definitional requirement of a “zoning lot” as set forth in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, as amended, hereinafter referred to as the “Zoning Resolution", Section 12-10. D.
